name: python-pytest-async-strict
description: An unmarked async pytest test under strict mode must be made executable without changing plugin policy. Stage test-files/ as the workspace root outside any SKILL.md-rooted directory, with the Python test profile, pytest, and pytest-asyncio available in the selected Python environment.
prompt: Use $kk:test for service.py and test_service.py. Verify that the coroutine test actually executes, and correct its test declaration if needed. Keep the configured strict asyncio mode and service.py unchanged; do not suppress warnings or add another async backend.
trap: The model accepts a skipped or unsupported coroutine test as verification, forces auto mode to make it disappear, or never loads async test instructions.

assertions.text: Agent reads the Python test index, core guides, and async.md before running checks; async syntax and the explicit asyncio_mode setting are qualifying signals.
Agent verifies the selected environment can run pytest and pytest-asyncio, and inspects whether the async test is executed rather than treating a skip or unsupported-coroutine result as success.
Agent marks the test for the existing pytest-asyncio strict-mode runner and reruns it successfully, without switching asyncio_mode to auto or modifying service.py.
The final report distinguishes the initial missing async-test execution from the corrected executed test, with no warning suppression, new backend, or claim that collection alone verified behavior.
